title: PrestaShop preview manifest, v0
description: Describes the shop to start: which code, which PHP, which modules and which data. Inspired by WordPress Playground blueprints.

prestashop.description: The code to run. At least one of ref and commit.

ref.description: A branch (9.2.x), a tag (9.2.0) or a pull request head (pull/42938/head). Never falls back to another ref when it does not exist.

commit.description: Pins the exact commit. Takes precedence over ref, which then only documents where the commit comes from.

base.description: The maintained branch the code belongs to, which picks the Flashlight image. Read from the pull request when ref is pull/N/head, from ref when it is a maintained branch.

php.description: PHP version. Defaults to the one the Flashlight image recommends for the base.

debug.description: PrestaShop debug mode (_PS_MODE_DEV_). Off by default: the vendor is installed without dev packages

profile.description: A predefined data set on top of the default seed (John DOE, 5 orders, demo catalog). multistore is not implemented in v0.

modules.description: Modules installed after the code overlay, in order.

github.description: owner/name, built from source with composer

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit for github

config.description: ps_configuration values, global scope. Applied after the profile.

sql.description: SQL files, relative to the manifest, run after the config. PREFIX_ is replaced by the table prefix.
